title: [Bounty $7.5k] Optimise and improve precision of sin/cos/tan
description: - sin/cos suffer minor precision loss due to rounding due to the use of sinpi(x / π). - tan is poorly optimised due to the use of two separate polynomials, and has severe precision issues for 1.5 < |x| < π/2.  Proposed solution:  - adjust sin/cos to use polynomials on the range [-π/2, π/2]. - adjust tan to have better precision and performance.  This may require specialised implementations for WH/BH due to the need for reciprocal.
